notes.title: Steam Cloud Saving!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319298/5326bd803add1a9c602a94072266fc240a97fa53.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26319298/550b1c52668be2d2abaada06880e1e2c23825b03.png[/img][/url]

Once you exit the game, your save file will be synchronized with the Steam Cloud. 
You can then [b]play the game on any different device and quickly resume where you left off![/b]
